Initial release of Competitor Watch Pro.

- Automatically tracks competitor pricing, product updates, hiring activity, content, and marketing campaigns.
- Monitors changes across websites and social channels.

- Simple setup: just provide competitor names or URLs.
- No extra API keys required; works with any OpenClaw agent.
